Therefore CIN/LLPIN, PAN (and its 4th-character holder type), GSTIN, GST status, incorporation date, registered-office state, MCA status and audited revenue for FY25/FY26 are all null — not public in any source I could reach, and I will not invent them. No basis to reject: absence of retrievable records is NOT evidence that the entity does not exist, is struck off, liquidated or bankrupt, so the company is retained in the database. Role is 'unknown' — the claimed industry ('Нефтегаз и химия') and declared HS 392690 (plastic articles) are unverified and, per project rules, HS mismatch is not a rejection ground; the HS code should be corrected to the actual code once the company's real product line is established. state_claimed was empty in the input, so no state comparison is possible. Recommended next step: re-run verification when MCA master-data / GST portal access or a working search backend is available, and obtain the CIN from the supplier's own documents (GST certificate / invoice) to anchor the lookup.
